Giraffes are mammals that have long necks. This enables them to eat leaves from tall trees. One
theory to explain how giraffes developed long necks is natural selection.
Which statement is part of the explanation for the development of long necks in giraffes by
natural selection?

options.text: Giraffes with longer necks were better adapted to the environment than giraffes with shorter necks.
Humans selected giraffes with the longest necks and bred them together.
There was no competition for food.
There were no trees in the environment.

questions.questionText:
Alpine plants grow on mountains at high altitude. Alpine plants can only grow for a few months
because they are covered in snow for most of the year.
What are most likely to be adaptive features of alpine plants?

options.text: They flower quickly and produce seeds quickly.
They flower quickly and produce seeds slowly.
They flower slowly and produce seeds quickly.
They flower slowly and produce seeds slowly.
